model.rangeMethod: 10–90 percentile volatility-bootstrap sensitivity; not a calibrated confidence interval
limitations: CL=F is a futures proxy, not the TVC:USOIL feed.
Log-price model rejects zero and negative prices.
Hourly observations include overnight/roll gaps; rolling futures need adjustment before production validation.
Student-t endpoints use an approximate Gaussian bridge. Same-bin barrier ties count as stop-first.
CME weekday/DST calendar approximation excludes holidays and early closes.
Three-month windows use 90 calendar days; one-month uses 30.
No fitted news, geopolitical, OVX, regime or fundamental adjustments are active.
